intentComment: Story 099 (sprint Balancexit, docs/BalancerWinddownPlan.md section 4 'Holding pattern until the cutover'). ONE owner transaction, BalancerPoolerV2(0x7f6874332c4629429d70D15f685A8230323F11F1).incrementAuthVersion(), revokes all four authorized poolers at once (OWNER, MultiPooler 0xd1E5...7b51, 0x186c...a77F, 0x6309...d476) so nobody can pool() sUSDS into the dying Balancer pool before the exit cutover; mints are unaffected (dispatch is onlyMinter) and sUSDS simply accumulates on the pooler. REQUIRED precondition of the story-103 mainnet cutover (step 0). Idempotent: if all four are already unauthorized the script sends nothing. Changes no addresses, so :broadcast has NO mainnet-addresses backup/patcher tail. :preview = fork simulation as OWNER (PREVIEW_MODE=true, nothing signed); :broadcast = Ledger m/44'/60'/46'/0/0 (gas price BALANCER_HOLDING_GAS_PRICE_WEI, default 0.3 gwei) then the mandatory && :verify; :verify = read-only script/VerifyBalancerHolding.s.sol, require()s poolerAuthVersion[p] != authVersion for all four (the onlyAuthorizedPooler predicate) and fails 'verify: pooler still authorized' until the broadcast lands.

preview.mechanism: PREVIEW_MODE=true -> vm.startPrank(OWNER) around incrementAuthVersion(); nothing signed. Runs against live RPC_MAINNET (a fork of head), not --fork-url.

broadcast.command: export BALANCER_HOLDING_GAS_PRICE_WEI=${BALANCER_HOLDING_GAS_PRICE_WEI:-300000000} && forge script script/RevokeBalancerPoolersHoldingPattern.s.sol:RevokeBalancerPoolersHoldingPattern --rpc-url $RPC_MAINNET --sender 0xCad1a7864a108DBFF67F4b8af71fAB0C7A86D0B6 --broadcast --skip-simulation --slow --ledger --hd-paths "m/44'/60'/46'/0/0" --legacy --with-gas-price $BALANCER_HOLDING_GAS_PRICE_WEI --gas-estimate-multiplier 200 -vvv && npm run balancer-holding:verify
notes: --skip-simulation: forge skips the on-chain re-simulation of the recorded tx; the script's own post-requires (authVersion bumped exactly once, all four unauthorized) still run in forge's local execution before the tx is sent.
PREVIEW_MODE unset -> vm.envOr default false -> vm.startBroadcast() (Ledger).
Fixed legacy gas price 0.3 gwei default; a low gas price can leave the tx pending (no replacement logic). Not judged here.
No `npm run balancer-holding:preview` prefix; no mainnet-addresses backup/patcher tail (no addresses change).

verify.mechanism: view run(); require(!_isAuthorized(p)) for the four named poolers; fails 'verify: pooler still authorized' until the broadcast lands. Expected to FAIL today (live authVersion == 1, all four at 1).

post: npm run balancer-holding:verify (forge, read-only; no node script)

introducedBy.subject: [story-099] Add BalancerPoolerV2 holding-pattern revocation script, read-only verifier and mainnet fork test
